texts.preamble: Surat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 March, 2024 Author: Milind Ramesh Phadke Bench: Milind Ramesh Phadke 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Gwalior Before Hon'Ble Shri Justice Milind Ramesh Phadke On The 18 th Of March, 2024 Writ Petition No. 5174 of 2024 Between:- Surat Singh S/O Shri Brajlal Kushwah, Aged 43 Ye A R S , Occupation: Sarpanch Resident Of Village Chakrampur District Shivpuri (Madhya Pradesh) (Shri Siddharth Sharma- Advocate For Petitioner) And 1. The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through Principal Secretary Department Of Panchayat And Rural Development, Vallabh Bhawan Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh) 2. Commissioner Panchayatraj , Madhya Pradesh, Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh) 3. Co Llecto R Shivpuri District Shivpuri (Madhya Pradesh) 4. Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue) Karera District Shivpuri (Madhya Pradesh) .. (Shri Ps Raghuvanshi- Government Advocate For Respondents- State)
texts.arguments: ORDER The short controversy involved in this writ petition revolves around the mandate contained under Section 39 of the Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993 (herein after referred to as 'Act 1993') dealing with power of suspension of office bearer of Panchayat. Shri Sharma, learned counsel for the petitioner contends that petitioner- Sarpanch has been put under suspension by the impugned order dated 24-11- 2023 (Annexure P/1) purportedly on the ground that a case has been registered against the petitioner vide FIR at Crime No. 321 of 2023 for offences punishable under Sections 147, 148, 149, 307, 435, 323, 324 and added Section 302 of IPC, whereas the power under Section 39(1)(a) of the Act, 1993 vests with the competent authority to suspend an office-bearer of Panchayat, if against him the charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under [Chapters V-A, VI, IX] ------------------- ------------------- ------------------------ as contemplated under the said provisions. Hence, the impugned order is without jurisdiction. Further, it is contended on behalf of petitioner that the petitioner has been placed under suspension in absence of charge framed. Referring to the reasons indicated in the impugned order, it is stated that so far investigation is in progress and challan has not been filed. As such no charges have been framed against the petitioner, therefore, the impugned order is patently illegality and cannot be sustained in the eyes of law. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondents No.1 to 4/State supports the order impugned and prays for dismissal of this petition. For ready reference, Section 39 (1)(a) of the Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993 is quoted below: 39. Suspension of office-bearer of Panchayat. - (1) The prescribed authority may suspend from office any office-bearer,- (a) against whom charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under [Chapters V-A, VI, IX], IX-A, X, XII, Sections 302, 303, 304-B, 305, 306, 312 to 318, 366-A, 366-B, 373 to 377 of Chapter XVI, Sections 395 to 398, 408, 409, 458 to 460 of Chapter XVII and Chapter XVIII of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (XLV of 1860) or under any Law for the time being in force for the prevention of adulteration of food stuff and drugs, [suppression of immoral traffic in women and children, Protection of Civil Rights and Prevention of Corruption]; or A careful reading of the aforesaid provision suggests that unless; charges have been framed in any criminal proceedings under the provisions described thereunder, the office-bearer of Panchayat cannot be placed under suspension in exercise of powers under Section 39(1)(a) of the Act, 1993.
